confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated 2026 cost-of-living snapshots (Numbeo-derived via Expatica, Expatexchange, Pocketwise) and are medium confidence. Beer is based on 2026 Morning Advertiser pub-pint averages, not restaurant menus. Cocktail and wine are low confidence: the only figures found were consumer willingness-to-pay surveys, so both are bounded by the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Manchester city-centre pricing; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the 2026-11-18 value (0.6720 USD per AUD) was taken from a third-party mirror that reports the RBA 4.00 pm observation. I did not confirm it against the RBA F11.1 table, so verify it before use. The GBP-to-USD basis for the USD anchors is roughly 1.32 USD per GBP.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Manchester as a large UK regional city, priced slightly below London and close to other major English regional centres such as Leeds and Birmingham. Food and drink use UK price surveys; accommodation uses regional UK city-centre hotel and hostel levels.
